notes: Low, long-bodied chibi ice dragon: body is compact in the front ~40% of length, tail is the rest (4 tail bones). Head is turned ~20 deg toward +X in the rest pose (like the Phoenix) - use the BODY forward axis (pelvis->chest), not head-pelvis, for gait/verify. Legs are short and stocky, near-vertical; paws flat. Spiky ice crest runs from the head down the back to the tail tip - weight spikes rigidly to the nearest spine/tail bone. Swept horns + small blue fin-ears: rigid to head. No wings. Personality: Wise, wry - calm, deliberate, a little smug. Attack = lunge + frost-breath head thrust (jaw open). Cast = rears up on hind legs slightly, head high. Victory = smug tail flick + head tilt. KO = slumps flat on its belly, legs splayed, head down.
